title: Payroll
subtitle: Compensation, payroll runs, approvals, payslips and reports.
ownSubtitle: Your compensation, payslips and payroll history.
demoNotice: Demo environment: fictional data. Payments, bank transfers and e-mails are never made or sent. Deductions are illustrative and not tax or legal advice.

common.typeEditHint: Changes apply to new assignments; existing assignments keep the values they were made with.

kpis.label: Payroll key figures
kpis.totalEmployeesHint: Employees with compensation in force today.
kpis.grossHint: Gross salaries of the last approved or paid payroll period.
kpis.netHint: Net salaries of the last approved or paid payroll period.
kpis.deductionsHint: Deductions of the last approved or paid payroll period.
kpis.pendingRunsHint: Runs in draft, calculated or rejected.
kpis.awaitingApprovalHint: Runs submitted and waiting for an approver.

overview.currentPeriodHint: Payroll runs for this month and their status.
overview.noCurrentRuns: No payroll run has been created for this month yet.
overview.noPayroll: There is no approved payroll yet. Figures appear once a run is approved.

cost.title: Monthly payroll cost
cost.subtitle: Basic salaries and allowances of approved and paid runs ({{currency}})

grossNet.title: Gross versus net salary
grossNet.subtitle: Approved and paid runs per month ({{currency}})

ranges.title: Salary distribution
ranges.subtitle: Employees by monthly basic salary range ({{currency}})

issues.noEmployees: No employee could be calculated for this run.
issues.periodNotEnded: The period has not ended yet: attendance and leave can still change before payment.
issues.inAnotherRun: Already included in another payroll run for this period — not calculated again.
issues.missingCompensation: No compensation in force for the period — not included.
issues.currencyMismatch: Paid in another currency — not included in this run.
issues.negativeNet: Deductions exceed gross salary (negative net). Correct the deductions before submitting.
issues.partialCompensation: Compensation covers only part of the employed days; uncovered days are not paid.
issues.currencySkipped: A fixed amount in another currency was skipped.
issues.attendanceIncomplete: Attendance data does not cover the whole period yet.
issues.inputsChanged: Compensation, leave, attendance or configuration changed since the calculation. Recalculate before submitting.
issues.partialPeriod: Employed for part of the period (prorated).

runs.title: Payroll runs
runs.search: Search by run number or department
runs.created: Payroll run {{number}} was created as a draft.
runs.saved: The run was saved as a draft.
runs.notFound: This payroll run does not exist.
runs.monthHint: Monthly runs cover one calendar month.
runs.paymentHint: From the start of the period up to 31 days after it ends.
runs.frequencyHint: Only monthly payroll is supported in this version.
runs.editRejectedHint: Editing a rejected run returns it to draft and discards its calculation.
runs.workflowHint: Workflow: Draft → Calculated → validated → Pending approval → Approved → Paid. Creators never approve their own run.
runs.totalsHint: Sums of the employee lines below.
runs.validated: Validation passed: the run can be submitted.
runs.validatedWithErrors: Validation found errors that block submission.
runs.submitted: The run was submitted for approval.
runs.validateFirst: Validate the calculation before submitting it for approval.
runs.fixErrors: Fix the errors below, recalculate and validate again before submitting.
runs.ownRun: You created this run, so you cannot approve or reject it. Another approver must decide.
runs.awaitingApprover: Waiting for an approver (HR Administrator or System Administrator).
runs.correctHint: Correct the inputs, recalculate, validate and submit again (or edit the run).
runs.approvedNote: Approved payroll is final: it cannot be recalculated. Marking it as paid is a simulated administrative record.
runs.paidNote: Paid (simulated record): this run is final and cannot be changed. No bank transfer was made.
runs.approveText: The calculation becomes final. Payslips can then be generated.
runs.rejectHint: Explain what must be corrected. The reason is recorded and shown to the payroll team.
runs.paidText: This only records the payment in the demo. No money is transferred and no bank or employee is notified.
runs.markedPaid: The run was recorded as paid (simulated).
runs.payslipsText: Issues a payslip for every employee of the run who does not have one yet. Employees can then see their own payslip.
runs.cancelHint: A cancelled run releases its period. The reason is recorded.

lines.notFound: This employee is not part of the run.
lines.snapshotHint: This is the stored calculation. Later changes to compensation, leave or attendance do not change it until the run is recalculated (only possible before approval).
lines.overtimeNote: Overtime is not paid: attendance has no approved overtime data.
lines.deductionsNote: Only approved unpaid leave, enabled policies and assigned deductions. Lateness is never deducted.

inputs.noLeave: No approved leave in the period.
inputs.noAttendance: No attendance data for this period (outside the attendance data window). Scheduled working days: {{days}}.
inputs.attendanceNote: Attendance is shown for reference. Absences cost money only when an absence deduction is enabled; lateness and extra time never change pay.

compensation.title: Employee compensation
compensation.search: Search by name or employee number
compensation.missing: No compensation has been set for this employee.
compensation.onlyScheduled: Compensation starts on a future date (see history).
compensation.historySubtitle: Every change is a new record; earlier records are never overwritten.
compensation.otherDeductionsNote: Unpaid leave, absence and statutory deductions apply automatically when enabled — see
compensation.historyHint: This creates a new salary record from the effective date. The current record ends the day before; history is kept.
compensation.structureHint: Only active structures for the employment type ({{type}}).
compensation.amountHint: Exact amount, e.g. 1250.500 — no rounding is applied.
compensation.effectiveHint: Must be after the latest record and after any approved or paid payroll period.
compensation.oneTimeHint: Paid once, in the period of the effective date.
compensation.perPeriodHint: Applied in every period while in force.
compensation.openEndedHint: Leave empty for no end date.
compensation.endHint: The last day the item applies. It cannot reach into an approved or paid period.

structures.title: Salary structures
structures.hint: Structures give a default monthly basic salary per role level. Each employee's own salary is set in Compensation. All amounts are examples.
structures.formHint: Changing a structure does not change any employee's salary: salary records keep their own amount.
structures.deactivateText: It can no longer be assigned. Employees already on it keep their salary records.

allowances.title: Allowance types
allowances.hint: Allowances are assigned to individual employees with effective dates. Amounts are examples, not a policy.
allowances.taxableHint: Configuration only: no tax is calculated in this version.
allowances.deactivateText: Types with current or scheduled assignments cannot be deactivated.

deductions.title: Deduction types
deductions.legalNotice: Illustrative configuration: no tax, social-security or labour-law calculation is implemented or claimed. Statutory deductions stay disabled until a verified legal policy is approved.
deductions.statutoryWarning: Statutory deductions are illustrative only and apply to every employee of a run while active.
deductions.systemHint: Calculated by the system from approved leave or attendance: daily rate = monthly basic ÷ policy divisor.
deductions.startsInactive: It is created inactive; activate it explicitly when the policy is approved.
deductions.categoryLocked: The category cannot change after creation.
deductions.deactivateText: Nothing is deducted for this type in later calculations. Types with current assignments cannot be deactivated.

policy.title: Calculation policy
policy.subtitle: The rules every calculation uses (stored with each run).
policy.roundingValue: Each line is rounded once, half-up, to the currency's smallest unit (JOD: 3 decimals). Totals add the rounded lines.
policy.prorationValue: Basic salary × days covered ÷ calendar days of the period.
policy.recurringValue: Recurring items apply in full while in force; one-time items in the period of their date.
policy.overtimeValue: Not paid (no overtime data or policy).
policy.leaveValue: Only approved unpaid leave is deducted; each day once.
policy.editHint: Applies to calculations from now on. Calculated, approved and paid runs keep the divisor they used.

payslips.title: Payslips
payslips.hint: Payslips are issued only from approved or paid payroll runs.
payslips.search: Search by payslip number or employee
payslips.notFound: This payslip does not exist or is not available to you.
payslips.pdfHint: “Download PDF” opens the print dialog: choose “Save as PDF”. The file is created by your browser; nothing is uploaded.
payslips.printUnavailable: Printing is not available in this browser.
payslips.approvedNotPaid: Approved payroll; payment not yet recorded.

payslip.title: Payslip
payslip.footer: Generated by DataHub HR (demo). Fictional data; deductions are illustrative and not tax or legal advice.

reports.hint: Reports include approved and paid payroll only, in the organisation's currency. Exports contain only what you are allowed to see.
reports.subtitle: {{from}} – {{to}} · amounts in {{currency}}
reports.empty: No approved payroll matches these filters.
reports.fixFilters: Check the period: the end must not precede the start (at most 24 months).

my.noCompensation: Your compensation has not been set up yet.
my.noEmployeeRecord: No employee record is linked to this account, so there is no payroll to show.
my.historyHint: One line per payslip (approved payroll only).
my.privacyNote: Only your own payroll is shown. Other employees' salaries and organisation figures are never sent to your browser.

validation.invalidCode: Use capital letters, digits and hyphens (up to 20).
validation.invalidAmount: Enter an amount with at most the currency's decimals (JOD 3, others 2).
validation.positiveAmount: The amount must be greater than zero.
validation.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage from 0.01 to 100 (2 decimals).
validation.positivePercent: The percentage must be greater than zero.
validation.noteRequired: Explain the reason for an adjustment or correction.
validation.dailyRateRequired: Unpaid leave and absence deductions use the daily rate.
validation.dailyRateSystemOnly: The daily rate is only for unpaid leave and absence.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end must be on or after the start.
validation.paymentDateRange: Choose a date from the start of the period to 31 days after it ends.
validation.invalidDivisor: Enter a whole number from 1 to 31.

serverErrors.stateChanged: This record changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.
serverErrors.structureInUse: Employees use this structure: its currency cannot change.
serverErrors.employmentTypeNotAllowed: This structure does not apply to the employee's employment type.
serverErrors.beforeHire: This is before the employee's hire date.
serverErrors.overlapsExisting: It overlaps an existing record: choose a later date.
serverErrors.periodClosed: This reaches into a payroll period that is already approved or paid.
serverErrors.typeInUse: Employees still have this type assigned.
serverErrors.duplicateSystemType: Another active type already deducts for this cause.
serverErrors.notAssignable: This deduction applies automatically; it is not assigned to individuals.
serverErrors.notEarlier: Choose a date before the current end date.
serverErrors.notEditable: Only draft or rejected runs can be edited.
serverErrors.notCalculable: This run can no longer be calculated.
serverErrors.hasErrors: The run has errors that block submission.
serverErrors.notPending: This run is not waiting for approval.
serverErrors.ownRun: You created this run: another approver must decide.
serverErrors.notApproved: The run must be approved first.
serverErrors.notCancellable: Approved and paid runs cannot be cancelled.
serverErrors.duplicatePeriod: A payroll run already covers these employees for this period.
serverErrors.calendarMonth: Monthly runs must cover one calendar month.
